SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1923 South Jefferson Street
From CJ-2 to B2-2

The Property

The property is a vacant lot located in a Transit Served Location within 2,640 feet to the Halsted METRA station.
The immediate area along Jefferson is predominantly residential with multi-unit residential buildings ranging from
two to four stories.

The Project
KEY DEVELOPMENT GROUP LLC (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to allow a four-story

residential building (approx. 44’-10” height) with four units, four bicycle spaces, and a detached two car garage.

To allow the proposed project, the Applicant seeks a change in zoning classification for the subject property from
a C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District to a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-A for
relief under section 17-13-1003-EE(2) to allow an increase in parking for properties in a Transit Served Location
to a qualifying train station from two required parking spaces to four spaces; 2) an optional variation under section
17-13-1101-A for relief under section 17-13-1003-P to allow a 6’-9” front yard setback versus a maximum of 5’
as required per section 17-3-0504-B; and 3) an optional variation under section 17-13-L101-A for relief under
section 17-13-1003-A to allow a reduction in MLA by 117.5 square feet to allow a fourth unit.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,882.5 square feet

Maximum FAR: 2.2

Floor Area: 7,721 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 4

MLA Density: 882.5 square feet*

Height: 447-10"

Bicycle Parking: 4

Automobile Parking: 4*

Setbacks: Front (Jefferson): e-9*
North: 1.0’
South: 3.0°
Rear (east/alley): 43°-6 5/8”

A set of plans is attached.

* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
